# Sainam Technology - Website & MVP Development

Sainam Technology is a specialized development agency based in Mumbai, India, serving clients globally in the US, Europe, and India. We focus on building high-quality, scalable websites and Minimum Viable Products (MVPs) for startups and growing businesses.

## Core Services
- **Website Development:** Custom, high-performance, and SEO-optimized websites using modern frameworks.
- **MVP Development:** Rapid product development for startups to validate ideas and scale.
- **Local Expertise:** Serving Mumbai, Palghar, Vasai, Virar, and Dahanu regions.
